item.text:
**Verdict**  
Mostly yes, with caveats. I found strong evidence that Sharif’s 2024 welfare delivery was framed and implemented as broadly nonpartisan, especially through BISP and Ramazan relief. I did not find clear 2024 proof that welfare, jobs, permits, or food/housing benefits were systematically used to reward loyalists or punish opponents. The main counterevidence is broader coercive treatment of vulnerable groups, not a documented patronage system.

**Accepted Claims**
- [BENAZIR INCOME SUPPORT PROGRAMME HELPS ALL POOR AND DESERVING PEOPLE IRRESPECTIVE OF ANY POLITICAL AFFILIATION: CHAIRPERSON OF THE BENAZIR INCOME SUPPORT PROGRAMME RUBINA KHALID](https://www.bisp.gov.pk/NewsDetail/MjU0NDA1ZTItM2NiOC00NGE4LWJmNzctNGFiZTY4ZDFiZGFj) | BISP | 2024-05-23 | BISP said assistance goes to poor and deserving people regardless of political affiliation, with no registration fee and a transparent, dignified process. This is direct evidence against using welfare as a loyalty tool. | IDs: `6B.7`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- [PM announces Rs 7.5 billion Ramazan relief package for poor people](https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-announces-rs-7-5-billion-ramazan-relief-package-for-poor-people/) | APP | 2024-03-07 | Sharif announced a subsidy-based relief package for poor and middle-income households, paired with BISP disbursement, complaint handling, and anti-hoarding enforcement. The package was presented as a broad anti-inflation measure, not a loyalty screen. | IDs: `6B.7`, `6B.2`, `6B.6`
- [PM enhances Ramazan package to Rs12.5 billion](https://www.dawn.com/news/1820615) | Dawn | 2024-03-11 | The government expanded the package, routed food relief through Utility Stores and BISP mobile units, and used mobile distribution and GPS-tracked trucks. That looks like mass welfare delivery rather than selective political favoritism. | IDs: `6B.7`, `6B.2`, `6B.6`
- [PM Shehbaz directs full digitalization of social welfare payments under BISP](https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-shehbaz-directs-full-digitalization-of-social-welfare-payments-under-bisp/) | APP | 2024-03-18 | Sharif ordered BISP disbursements onto digital wallets to curb leakages, improve transparency, and reduce queues and discretion. This is strong evidence for depoliticized, rule-based welfare delivery. | IDs: `6B.7`, `6B.5`, `6B.2`
- [Pakistan must halt unlawful deportation of Afghan refugees](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/pakistan-government-must-halt-deportation-of-afghan-refugees/) | Amnesty International | 2024-04-04 | Amnesty said Pakistan’s repatriation plan lacked transparency, due process, and accountability, and threatened arrests, harassment, and unlawful deportation of Afghan status-holders. This is negative evidence on permits, documentation, and access to employment/education for a vulnerable group. | IDs: `6B.7`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- [Pakistan: Abusive Forced Evictions in Pakistan](https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/05/28/i-escaped-only-my-life/abusive-forced-evictions-pakistan) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-05-28 | HRW reported forcible evictions of low-income residents, shop owners, and street vendors without adequate notice, compensation, or resettlement, with loss of housing and livelihoods. That cuts against a clean reading that housing and livelihood policy were insulated from coercive state abuse. | IDs: `6B.7`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- [Pakistan: Widening Crackdown on Dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | HRW said the government failed to ensure adequate social security, harmed access to health/food/adequate living standards, and deported undocumented Afghans without safeguards. This is broader coercive counterevidence, though it is not direct proof of welfare-for-loyalty patronage. | IDs: `6B.7`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`, `6B.1`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find clear 2024 evidence that Sharif’s government systematically tied BISP, Ramazan aid, public jobs, permits, or food/housing benefits to political loyalty.
- The strongest negative evidence is instead about punitive treatment of vulnerable groups, refugees, and low-income residents.
- So the record supports “formal welfare delivery was mostly nonpartisan,” but it does not prove a fully clean state.
